market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC is at ~$78,060 and must drop 42% to $45,000 within ~8 months. Bitcoin has historically seen 60%+ drawdowns in bear markets, but $45k from current levels would be the worst bear-market crash since 2022. Current macro has Iran war driving risk-off sentiment, but BTC is on track for its best April in a year. An 8-month window is long enough for a major correction but 42% is a very deep cut.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Long horizon (8 months) and severity of required drop; geopolitical macro uncertainty
